section.title: Account
section.subtitle: Name, email, password, version signature and sign-ins to this account.

profile.title: Profile
profile.sub: How colleagues see you in projects and organizations.
profile.name: Name

email.hint: A link is sent to the new address. Until you open it, the current address stays.
email.invalid: This does not look like an email address.

sent.title: A link was sent to {{email}}
sent.body: Open it from the email to switch the address. Until then the current one stays.

password.title: Password
password.sub: Changing it requires the current password.
password.same: The new password equals the current one.
password.signOutOthersHint: Recommended if someone else may have the password. This session stays.
password.ssoOnly: This account signs in through your organization's single sign-on and has no password of its own.

commit.title: Version signature
commit.sub: The name and address recorded in project version history and in external repositories.
commit.name: Name in versions
commit.nameHint: Empty: the account name is used.

noreply.title: Hidden address
noreply.hint: A Studio address like id@noreply…: your email is not published anywhere.

account.title: Account email
account.hint: Versions will show the address of your account.

own.title: Own address
own.hint: A separate address for versions only, for example the one linked to your GitHub.

commit.ownInvalid: This does not look like an email address.
commit.privateNote: Your real email will not reach the project history or any external repository.
commit.publicNote: This address is written into versions for good, and anyone with access to an external repository will see it after you push.
commit.preview: A version will be signed as

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.sub: Devices signed in to this account.
sessions.currentHint: To end it, sign out of the account.

failure.password_policy: The password is too weak. Make it longer and less predictable.
failure.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
failure.csrf_failed: Your session is stale. Refresh the page and try again.
failure.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
failure.network: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
failure.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again later.
failure.last_login_method: This is your only sign-in method.
failure.not_found: Key not found. Reload the page.
failure.passkey_invalid: The passkey didn't work. Try again.
failure.passkey_limit: The passkey limit for the account is reached.
failure.passkeys_disabled: Passkey sign-in is turned off on this server.
failure.passkey_failed: The browser couldn't create or use the passkey. Try again.
failure.passkey_already_registered: This device's key is already on the account.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.sub: For the command line and scripts. A token acts as you, so keep it like a password.
tokens.empty: No tokens yet. Create one when you need the CLI or a script.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.namePlaceholder: For example, CLI on my laptop
tokens.nameHint: So you can tell later where it is used.

api.title: API
api.hint: Projects, versions and builds on your behalf.

mcp.title: MCP
mcp.hint: AI clients (Claude, Cursor and others) work in the Studio on your behalf.

mcpAdmin.title: MCP: administration
mcpAdmin.hint: Admin MCP tools; for the instance administrator only.

expiry.neverHint: A token that never expires is riskier: revoke it once it is no longer needed.

created.label: Token “{{name}}”
created.hint: Paste it into the CLI or script settings.

identities.title: Sign-in methods
identities.sub: How you sign in to the account. Link your organization's single sign-on to skip the password.
identities.lockedHint: This is your only way to sign in, so it cannot be removed.
identities.soleNote: You have a single sign-in method. Add a second one before changing the first.
identities.lastMethod: This is your only way to sign in. Add another one first.
identities.linkHint: You will go to the provider and come back here with the link in place.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.sub: Sign in without a password: fingerprint, face or device PIN. The private key never leaves the device.
passkeys.empty: No passkeys yet. Add this device's key to sign in without a password.
passkeys.otherDomain: bound to {{domain}}, doesn't work at this address
passkeys.confirmDelete: Remove “{{name}}”? You won't be able to sign in with this key.
passkeys.disabledHint: The administrator turned passkey sign-in off, or the Studio address doesn't support it.
passkeys.unsupportedHint: This browser doesn't support passkeys, or the page isn't served over HTTPS.
passkeys.limitHint: At most {{count}} passkeys per account. Remove one to add another.
passkeys.domainHint: The key will be bound to {{domain}}. If the server address changes, you'll need to add it again.
passkeys.hint: A key is bound to the server address.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.body: You can add and remove passkeys only right after confirming your identity.
reauth.ssoBody: This account has no password or passkey. Sign in again with your provider, then repeat the action.
reauth.signInAgain: Sign out and sign in again, then repeat the action.
